Oman Family Visa Cost Calculator

Enter your family members and residence term to see the fees at issue and the yearly cost after that.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your family residence cost

Family residence fees in Oman

ItemAmount (OMR)For and when
Family joining visa30Wife and children under 21, first time
Visa renewal30Each renewal
Family visa for parents30At the authority's discretion
Resident card5 for one year, 10 for two, 15 for threeAdults and children over 10
Medical test30Adults, each issue and renewal

Example: a wife and two children over 10, two-year cycle: visas 90, cards 30 and medical 30 = OMR 150, then OMR 75 a year. If the children are under 10, it is OMR 20 less.

A salary of at least OMR 150 has been required since February 2023. Resident card fees were cut in 2025 to 5, 10 and 15 from 6 and 11. For your net pay after contributions use the Oman net salary calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a family joining visa in Oman?

OMR 30 for the visa and 30 for each renewal, and the resident card costs OMR 5 for one year, 10 for two and 15 for three since Decision 78/2025, required for adults and children over 10.

What salary do you need to bring your family to Oman?

OMR 150 a month since February 2023, down from 350; an old English police page still says 600.

Is health insurance mandatory for dependents in Oman?

We found no health insurance requirement for dependents as of November 2026, so the calculator does not add it.
